resources.string: The BRI Calculator helps you quickly understand if your body shape falls within a healthy range. BRI (Body Roundness Index) is an advanced method that focuses on body shape and fat distribution, providing more insight than the traditional BMI.\n\nBRI is a numerical value that estimates body fat and body shape based on your height and waist circumference. It specifically targets abdominal fat, which is strongly linked to health risks.

BRI is calculated based on your height and waist circumference (measured in meters).

Formula:
BRI = 364.2 − 365.5 × √(1 − (waist ÷ (π × height))²)

If your waist circumference is 85 cm (0.85 m) and your height is 1.75 m

First calculate the part inside the formula:
(0.85 ÷ (π × 1.75))² ≈ (0.85 ÷ 5.50)² ≈ (0.1545)² ≈ 0.0239

Then:
√(1 − 0.0239) = √(0.9761) ≈ 0.988
BRI = 364.2 − (365.5 × 0.988) ≈ 364.2 − 361.1 ≈ 3.1

Your BRI value can be interpreted as follows:

• Less than 3.4: Lean body (low body fat)
• 3.5 – 5.4: Healthy range
• 5.5 – 6.9: Increased body fat
• 7.0 and higher: High health risk

BRI gives a better indication of health risks related to abdominal fat. Fat around the waist is strongly associated with conditions such as:

• Heart disease
• Type 2 diabetes
• High blood pressure

Therefore, BRI can offer more insight into health risks than BMI alone.

Although BRI is more advanced than BMI, it still has limitations. It does not measure body fat directly and does not fully account for:

• Muscle mass
• Bone structure
• Age and gender differences
• Fitness level
• Use BRI as a guideline, not as a medical diagnosis.\n• Combine it with other health indicators.\n• Consult a healthcare professional for a complete evaluation.
BRI is a useful tool to gain insight into your body shape and potential health risks. However, it should always be viewed in the proper context, as your overall health depends on many factors.
